metadata.title: Personal Greeting
metadata.description: Read a name with input() and greet the user with a string concatenation.

instructions.main: Ask the user for their name, then greet them by printing `Hello, <name>!`.
steps: Read the name with `input("What is your name?")` — the prompt text must match exactly.
Build the greeting from the name: `Hello, ` + name + `!`.
Print the greeting on its own line.

hints.message: Read the name with `name = input("What is your name?")`, then print the greeting.
The name must come from the user — read it with `input(...)` instead of printing a fixed greeting.
`+` can only join strings. `len(name)` is a number — wrap it in `str(...)` or use an f-string instead.

evaluation.feedback_on_all_pass: You asked for the name and greeted the user exactly.

test_cases.feedback_on_fail: Ask for the name with exactly `input("What is your name?")`.
With the name Ada, print exactly `Hello, Ada!`.
